stem: Based on the photograph and your knowledge of U.S. history, how did scientific developments such as the one shown affect the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: They contributed to a federal commitment to improving science and technology education.

options.label: B
options.text: They reduced international tensions and conflict by encouraging exchanges of space technology.

options.label: C
options.text: They resulted in reducing defense spending as the country prioritized space exploration.

options.label: D
options.text: They slowed innovations in consumer goods as corporations focused on weapons manufacturing.

visual_elements: A black and white photograph showing a model of Sputnik III at a public exhibition in Moscow, U.S.S.R., in 1958, with several people observing the exhibit.
